description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles says T Tristan Wirfs is moving around better.
items.impact: Wirfs remained sidelined with a hamstring injury. He could be back at practice soon.
items.title: Tristan Wirfs (hamstring) moving around better

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts signed RB Roydell Williams.
items.impact: Williams will compete for a depth role in the Colts backfield.
items.title: Roydell Williams signs with Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts activated CJ Allen from the PUP list.
items.impact: Allen has been cleared to return to practice.
items.title: CJ Allen activated by Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kool-Aid McKinstry told reporters his ankle isn't hurt that bad.
items.impact: McKinstry left practice early on Thursday. He is day-to-day for now.
items.title: Kool-Aid McKinstry dealing with minor ankle injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Broncos signed CB Sam Webb.
items.impact: Webb will compete for a depth role in the Broncos corner back room.
items.title: Sam Webb signs with Broncos

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills released Wande Owens.
items.impact: Owens will figure to seek another opportunity in training camp.
items.title: Wande Owens released by Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills signed CB D.J. Miller Jr.
items.impact: Miller will compete for a depth role in the Bills wide receiver room.
items.title: D.J. Miller Jr. signs with Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets signed WR Cam Camper.
items.impact: Camper will compete for a depth role in the Jets wide receiver room.
items.title: Cam Camper signs with Jets

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jets waived WR Gee Scott Jr.
items.impact: Scott will likely clear waivers.
items.title: Gee Scott Jr. waived by Jets

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said DT Ashton Gillotte left Friday's practice with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is. Gillotte will continue to be further evaluated.
items.title: Ashton Gillotte battling hamstring injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens activated CB Bilhal Kone from the PUP list.
items.impact: Kone has been cleared to return to training camp.
items.title: Bilhal Kone (knee) activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Ravens activated LB Adisa Isaac from the PUP list.
items.impact: Isaac has been cleared to return to practice.
items.title: Adisa Isaac (elbow) activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers signed TE Chamon Metayer.
items.impact: Metayer had nearly 100 catches and 1,000 yards combined at Arizona State and Cincinnati in college.
items.title: Chamon Metayer signs with Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Panthers placed WR Chris Brazzell II on injured reserve.
items.impact: Brazzell will undergo season-ending surgery on his torn LCL. He'll miss the upcoming season.
items.title: Chris Brazzell II placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Seahawks hosted OL Kion Smith for a workout.
items.impact: Smith was released by the Dolphins in June.
items.title: Kion Smith works out for Seahawks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans hosted LB Jahlani Tavai for a workout.
items.impact: Tavai was released by the Patriots back in March.
items.title: Jahlani Tavai works out for Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals hosted DT Brodric Martin for a workout.
items.impact: Martin spent time last season with the Chiefs, Steelers and Raiders in depth roles.
items.title: Brodric Martin works out for Cardinals

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers released K Lenny Krieg.
items.impact: Krieg will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Lenny Krieg released by Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers signed LS Cal Adomitis.
items.impact: Adomitis played 49 regular-season games and three postseason contests in three seasons in Cincinnati. He played nine games for the Eagles last season
items.title: Cal Adomitis signs with Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Steelers hosted veteran safety Rayshawn Jenkins for a workout.
items.impact: Jenkins played last year with the Browns. He previously played for the Jaguars and Chargers in his career.
items.title: Rayshawn Jenkins works out for Steelers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Raiders waived/injured RB Chris Collier.
items.impact: Collier will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Chris Collier waived by Raiders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Raiders signed TE Zack Kuntz.
items.impact: Kuntz will compete for a depth role in the Raiders tight end room.
items.title: Zack Kuntz signs with Raiders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers signed WR Kaden Prather.
items.impact: Prather will compete in training camp for a depth role in the Packers wide receiver room.
items.title: Kaden Prather signs with Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers released WR Brenden Rice.
items.impact: Rice had signed with Green Bay entering training camp. He'll seek another opportunity.
items.title: Brenden Rice released by Packers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts hosted RB Marcus Major Jr. for a workout on Friday.
items.impact: Major will compete for a spot in training camp with the Colts. He played at Minnesota and most recently played for the UFL's Houston Gamblers earlier this year.
items.title: Marcus Major Jr. works out for Colts

title: Fantasy Player News
